## Business Summary
PKC Events provides complete event management solutions, including catering, venue arrangements, decoration, photography, makeup, and luxury vehicle services. The company specializes in wedding events, corporate functions, engagement ceremonies, birthday celebrations, and customized event planning.

- Kerala, India
- Malappuram
- Kozhikode
- Kochi
- Thrissur
- Palakkad
